test_cases.test_name: Site Activation Workflow with Document Verification
test_cases.objective: Verify that the configured site activation workflow properly enforces document checks and governance approvals before site activation
prerequisites: CTMS system is installed and configured
Test user accounts with appropriate roles created
Test study and site records available
Required document templates uploaded

test_steps.action: Log in as a clinical operations user and initiate site activation workflow for a test site
test_steps.expected_result: System displays the site activation workflow with required document checklist

test_steps.action: Upload all required documents for site activation (protocol, IB, consent form, etc.)
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts documents and updates checklist status for each document type

test_steps.action: Submit the site for activation approval through the configured workflow
test_steps.expected_result: System routes the request to appropriate approvers based on configured governance rules

test_steps.action: Log in as approver and complete the approval with electronic signature
test_steps.expected_result: System records approval with 21 CFR Part 11 compliant e-signature and activates the site

acceptance_criteria: Site activation workflow enforces all required document checks
Approval process follows configured governance rules
E-signatures are 21 CFR Part 11 compliant
Audit trail captures all workflow steps
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11
ICH E6 R2
FDA Clinical Trial Guidance
data_integrity_requirements: All workflow steps must be captured in audit trail
Document version control must be maintained
Approval signatures must be non-repudiable

test_cases.test_name: Role-Based Access Control for CRO and Sponsor Users
test_cases.objective: Verify that the configured role-based access control properly restricts user permissions based on organizational role and study assignment
prerequisites: CTMS system is installed and configured
Multiple test user accounts with different roles created
Test study records available
User provisioning system configured

test_steps.action: Log in as a CRO monitor user assigned to a specific study
test_steps.expected_result: User can access only assigned study data and monitoring functions

test_steps.action: Attempt to access financial management functions and sponsor-only reports
test_steps.expected_result: System denies access to unauthorized functions with appropriate error message

test_steps.action: Log in as sponsor clinical operations manager with broader access rights
test_steps.expected_result: User can access multiple studies and all operational functions except financial administration

test_steps.action: Log in as system administrator and verify user provisioning via SCIM integration
test_steps.expected_result: User accounts and permissions can be managed through SCIM API integration

acceptance_criteria: Users can only access functions and data appropriate to their role
Access denials are properly logged and secured
SCIM integration works for user provisioning
Role changes are immediately effective
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11
HIPAA Security Rule
GDPR Article 32
data_integrity_requirements: Access control must prevent unauthorized data modification
User permissions must be auditable
Security events must be logged and non-repudiable

test_cases.test_name: Site Activation Workflow with Document Checks
test_cases.objective: Verify that the configured site activation workflow correctly enforces required document checks and governance approvals before site activation.
prerequisites: CTMS system is installed and accessible
Test study created in the system
Test user accounts with Site Manager and Governance roles
Test site documentation (e.g., FDA 1572, CVs, lab certifications)

test_steps.action: Log into CTMS as a Site Manager and initiate the site activation workflow for a test study site.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays the site activation workflow with required document checklist.

test_steps.action: Upload test documents to the site activation checklist and submit for governance approval.
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts document uploads and updates checklist status accordingly.

test_steps.action: Log in as Governance user and review the submitted site activation package.
test_steps.expected_result: System presents complete document package for review with approval/rejection options.

test_steps.action: Approve the site activation package using 21 CFR Part 11-compliant e-signature.
test_steps.expected_result: System records approval with e-signature and updates site status to 'Activated'.

acceptance_criteria: Site activation workflow prevents activation until all required documents are submitted
E-signature process complies with 21 CFR Part 11 requirements
Audit trail captures all document submissions and approval actions
Site status correctly transitions through workflow states
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures
ICH E6 R2 - Section 5.20.1 Trial Management, Data Handling, and Record Keeping
data_integrity_requirements: All document submissions and approvals must be recorded in audit trail
E-signatures must be securely linked to their respective records
Workflow state changes must be timestamped and user-attributed
urs_requirements: URS-027-002: Implement site activation workflow with required document checks
URS-027-010: Support 21 CFR Part 11-compliant e-signatures for approvals

test_cases.test_name: Investigator Payment Configuration with Milestone Rules
test_cases.objective: Validate that the configured investigator payment system correctly calculates payments based on milestone rules and applies appropriate tax withholding.
prerequisites: CTMS system is installed and accessible
Test study with configured payment milestones
Test investigator profiles with tax withholding requirements
Financial user role access credentials

test_steps.action: Log into CTMS as a Financial Administrator and navigate to the payment configuration module.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays payment milestone rules and tax withholding settings for the test study.

test_steps.action: Simulate achievement of a payment milestone (e.g., first subject enrolled) for a test site.
test_steps.expected_result: System automatically generates a payment request with correct amount calculation.

test_steps.action: Review the generated payment request and verify tax withholding calculations based on investigator profile.
test_steps.expected_result: System applies correct tax withholding percentages and displays net payment amount.

test_steps.action: Approve the payment request and verify audit trail recording.
test_steps.expected_result: System records payment approval with timestamp and user attribution in audit trail.

acceptance_criteria: Payment milestones trigger automatic payment calculations
Tax withholding is correctly applied based on investigator profiles
All payment transactions are recorded in audit trail
Financial records are maintained per retention policy requirements
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures
ICH E6 R2 - Section 5.5 Compensation to Subjects and Investigators
data_integrity_requirements: Payment calculations must be reproducible and verifiable
All financial transactions must have complete audit trails
Tax withholding calculations must be accurate and documented
urs_requirements: URS-027-005: Configure investigator payments including milestone rules and tax withholding
URS-027-011: Retain monitoring visit reports and financial records per policy

test_cases.test_name: Monitoring Visit Workflow and Financial Milestone Configuration Test
test_cases.objective: Verify that the configured monitoring visit planning, reporting, and associated investigator payment milestone rules function correctly according to the vendor's workflow templates.
prerequisites: CTMS environment is installed and accessible
Test users with CRA and Finance roles are created and assigned appropriate permissions
A test clinical study and at least one test site are configured and activated in the system
Vendor templates for trip reports and follow-up letters are loaded

test_steps.action: Log in as a CRA user and navigate to the monitoring visit planning module for the test study.
test_steps.expected_result: User successfully logs in and can access the monitoring visit planning interface for the assigned study.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the monitoring visit planning dashboard

test_steps.action: Schedule a new monitoring visit for the test site, specifying the visit type, planned date, and objectives.
test_steps.expected_result: The system creates the visit record and displays it in the planned visits list with a status of 'Scheduled'.

test_steps.action: Complete the trip report using the configured vendor template, entering findings and actions required.
test_steps.expected_result: The trip report form is populated correctly, and all mandatory fields are completed and saved successfully.

test_steps.action: Generate and send a follow-up letter to the site using the configured template from the completed trip report.
test_steps.expected_result: The system generates a follow-up letter based on the trip report findings and confirms successful dispatch.
data_to_capture: Document ID of the follow-up letter

test_steps.action: Log in as a Finance user and verify that a payment milestone associated with the completed monitoring visit is triggered.
test_steps.expected_result: A payment milestone is automatically created in the financial module with the correct amount and linked to the appropriate site.

test_steps.action: Review the audit trail for the monitoring visit and associated financial milestone records.
test_steps.expected_result: A complete audit trail is available showing all user actions and data changes for the visit and payment records.
data_to_capture: Audit trail entries for the visit and payment records

acceptance_criteria: Monitoring visits can be planned, executed, and reported using the configured vendor templates
Follow-up letters are automatically generated from trip report data
Payment milestones are triggered automatically upon visit completion as per configured rules
All actions are captured in a compliant audit trail
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic records and signatures
ICH E6(R2) for monitoring activities and documentation
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail must capture all changes to visit status and financial data
Financial calculations must be accurate and consistent
Linkage between visit completion and payment milestones must be maintained
urs_requirements: URS-027-004: Implement monitoring visit planning, trip reports, and follow-up letters using vendor templates
URS-027-005: Configure investigator payments including milestone rules and tax withholding
URS-027-009: Maintain audit trail for subject and site data changes

test_cases.test_name: Risk-Based Monitoring Dashboard and KPI Configuration Test
test_cases.objective: Validate that the configured risk-based monitoring dashboards and key performance indicators (KPIs) accurately display study and site-level metrics for monitoring oversight.
prerequisites: CTMS environment is installed and accessible
Test study with multiple sites and subject data is populated
Monitoring visit and deviation data exists for the test study
User with Monitoring Oversight role is created and configured

test_steps.action: Log in as a user with Monitoring Oversight role and navigate to the risk-based monitoring dashboard.
test_steps.expected_result: The dashboard loads successfully and displays an overview of all assigned studies with high-level KPIs.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the main dashboard view

test_steps.action: Select the test study from the dashboard to view study-specific risk indicators and KPIs.
test_steps.expected_result: The system displays detailed study-level metrics including enrollment rate, deviation trends, and monitoring visit status.
data_to_capture: Values for key metrics like enrollment rate and deviation count

test_steps.action: Drill down into site-level performance metrics for the test study to view individual site data.
test_steps.expected_result: Site-level dashboard displays performance metrics for each site, highlighting sites requiring attention based on configured thresholds.
data_to_capture: Visual indicators for risk status (e.g., red/yellow/green)

test_steps.action: Filter the dashboard data by date range, region, or specific risk indicators to test configurability.
test_steps.expected_result: The dashboard updates to show only the filtered data, maintaining accurate calculations for all displayed metrics.

test_steps.action: Generate a standard enrollment and deviation status report from the dashboard interface.
test_steps.expected_result: The report generates within 15 seconds and contains accurate data matching the dashboard displays.
data_to_capture: Accuracy of data in report compared to dashboard

test_steps.action: Verify that the dashboard data refreshes correctly when new monitoring or subject data is added to the system.
test_steps.expected_result: Dashboard metrics update automatically or after refresh to reflect the most current data in the system.

acceptance_criteria: Risk-based monitoring dashboard displays accurate study and site-level KPIs
Dashboard filters and drill-down capabilities function correctly
Reports generate within the required performance threshold of 15 seconds
Data visualizations accurately represent the underlying clinical data
regulatory_basis: ICH E6(R2) requirements for risk-based monitoring approaches
21 CFR Part 11 for electronic reporting and data integrity
data_integrity_requirements: KPI calculations must be accurate and based on current system data
Dashboard displays must reflect real-time or near-real-time data updates
Report data must match source system records
urs_requirements: URS-027-006: Implement risk-based monitoring KPIs and dashboards
URS-027-008: Provide standard reports for enrollment, deviations, and SDV status
URS-027-013: Report generation < 15 seconds for 1M records

test_cases.test_name: Monitoring Visit Report Generation and Follow-up Letter Configuration
test_cases.objective: Verify that monitoring visit planning, trip report generation, and follow-up letter creation function correctly using vendor-configured templates
prerequisites: CTMS system configured with monitoring visit templates
Test user with monitor role permissions
Sample monitoring visit data created in system

test_steps.action: Log in as a monitoring user and navigate to the visit planning module
test_steps.expected_result: User successfully logs in and can access visit planning functionality

test_steps.action: Create a new monitoring visit plan with required details including site, date, and objectives
test_steps.expected_result: Visit plan is successfully created and saved in the system

test_steps.action: Complete a trip report using the vendor-configured template with findings and observations
test_steps.expected_result: Trip report is generated successfully with all required fields populated

test_steps.action: Generate a follow-up letter using the configured template and verify content
test_steps.expected_result: Follow-up letter is created with appropriate content and formatting

acceptance_criteria: All monitoring visit templates function as configured
Reports and letters generate within expected timeframes
Data integrity maintained throughout the process
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 compliance for electronic records
GCP requirements for monitoring documentation
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail captures all visit-related changes
Report content cannot be modified after finalization
Template configurations are version-controlled

test_cases.test_name: Investigator Payment Configuration and Tax Withholding Validation
test_cases.objective: Validate that investigator payment rules including milestone-based payments and tax withholding calculations function as configured
prerequisites: Payment configuration completed in CTMS
Test payment rules with milestones defined
Tax withholding rates configured

test_steps.action: Log in as finance user and navigate to payment management module
test_steps.expected_result: User successfully accesses payment functionality with appropriate permissions

test_steps.action: Create test payment records for multiple investigators with different milestone achievements
test_steps.expected_result: Payment records are created successfully with correct milestone recognition

test_cases.test_name: Integration Testing with EDC System via API
test_cases.objective: Verify that the CTMS successfully integrates with the Electronic Data Capture (EDC) system using standard APIs to exchange subject enrollment and visit data
prerequisites: CTMS system configured and operational
EDC test environment available
API credentials configured
Test data for subjects and visits prepared

test_steps.action: Configure API endpoint connection to EDC system in CTMS integration settings
test_steps.expected_result: Connection established successfully with valid authentication

test_steps.action: Trigger subject enrollment data sync from CTMS to EDC system via API
test_steps.expected_result: Subject enrollment data transmitted successfully and appears in EDC system

test_steps.action: Trigger visit completion data sync from EDC to CTMS system via API
test_steps.expected_result: Visit completion data received and updated in CTMS subject records

acceptance_criteria: API connection established successfully
Subject enrollment data synced accurately
Visit completion data updated in CTMS
No data loss or corruption during transmission
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 compliance for data integrity
GAMP 5 guidelines for configured systems
data_integrity_requirements: Data transmission must maintain accuracy and completeness
Audit trail must record all data exchanges
Data mapping must preserve original meaning

test_cases.test_name: Performance Testing for Report Generation with Large Datasets
test_cases.objective: Validate that the CTMS can generate standard reports within acceptable timeframes when processing large volumes of data (1M+ records)
prerequisites: CTMS system with performance monitoring enabled
Test database with 1M+ records loaded
Performance benchmarking tools available
Network connectivity verified

test_steps.action: Execute enrollment report generation for studies with 1M+ subject records
test_steps.expected_result: Report generated completely within 15 seconds as specified in requirements

test_steps.action: Execute deviations report generation for studies with 1M+ deviation records
test_steps.expected_result: Report generated completely within 15 seconds with all data accurately included

test_steps.action: Execute SDV status report generation for large multi-site studies
test_steps.expected_result: Report completes within performance requirements with correct status data

acceptance_criteria: All reports generate within 15 seconds for 1M+ records
System resources remain within acceptable limits
Report data is complete and accurate
No system crashes or timeouts during processing
regulatory_basis: FDA guidance on computerized systems in clinical trials
GAMP 5 performance qualification requirements
data_integrity_requirements: Reports must maintain data accuracy regardless of volume
No data truncation or corruption in large datasets
Calculation integrity must be preserved
